title: Jesus is Brought to Trial before Caiaphas
description: Jesus is taken to the high priest Caiaphas, where the Council seeks false testimony against him. Finally, two witnesses claim he said he could destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days. When the high priest puts him under oath, Jesus confirms that he is the Christ, the Son of God, and speaks of the Son of Man seated at the right hand of Power. He is found guilty of blasphemy and sentenced to death, then spat upon and beaten.
